evidence_class: synthetic pilot; not field evidence and not an UNREAL reproduction
question: In this fixed synthetic fixture, does same-model prompted selection and interpretation change retrieval/interpretation error association or downstream operation results relative to the lexical and different-model controls?
implementation_limit: The local Ollama service does not expose hidden representations. B and C use prompted ranking, not representation retrieval. Model Y is not retrieval-specialized.

X.role: condition A/B/C interpreter and condition C selector

Y.role: condition B selector and condition D interpreter

conditions.B: Model Y prompted selector; Model X interpreter
conditions.C: Model X prompted selector; same Model X interpreter
conditions.D: reuse the exact Model X selection from C; Model Y interpreter

case_design.wrong_hypothesis_probe: All six cases in the wrong_initial_hypothesis stratum; same fixed wrong hypothesis for selectors A, B, and C; candidate pool unchanged.

selector_pair_probe.control: Each single selector supplies its top-m items, where m is the pair set's realized unique item count.
selector_pair_probe.token_matching: Use Model X prompt_eval_count. Add declared non-evidence padding after END_EVIDENCE until the pair and both single controls have the same total prompt token count. Fail closed if exact matching cannot be obtained.

scores_and_calibration.prompted_selectors: Rank-derived score 1/log2(rank+1); this is not model confidence.
scores_and_calibration.fit: One logistic calibration mapping per selector, fit only on development cases; C=1, solver=liblinear, max_iter=1000, random_state=47048.
scores_and_calibration.target: verified versus invalid/conflicting source status; unknown is excluded from fitting and reported separately.
heldout_metrics: ROC AUC when both classes exist

primary_analysis.retrieval_error: At least one required decisive item is absent from top-k, or a pre-labeled misleading item ranks above at least one required decisive item within top-k.
primary_analysis.interpretation_error: Wrong non-abstaining root cause, or abstention when the locked labels say sufficient decisive evidence is present.
primary_analysis.primary_contrast: Condition C minus A in the retrieval/interpretation conditional error-risk difference at k=4, pooled across the predeclared misleading and wrong_initial_hypothesis strata.
primary_analysis.H1_support_gate: Both exact replay runs have a positive C-minus-A effect; the pooled point estimate is at least 0.15; the 95% stratified paired case bootstrap lower bound is above zero; and at least one predeclared downstream outcome changes in the same cases.

bootstrap.method: 95% percentile bootstrap, paired by case and stratified by case type

primary_analysis.downstream_decision: Aggregate audited claim-support votes by unique verified upstream source. Decide the top root cause only when it has at least two independent upstream sources and at least 0.60 of all eligible source votes; otherwise abstain.
primary_analysis.source_status_prediction: Compare held-out error log loss using source/derivation metadata features alone with the same fixed logistic analysis plus selector/interpreter lineage features. Fit on development cases only at k=4 and evaluate heldout cases at k=4. Report the paired per-case log-loss change with a 95% case-stratified percentile bootstrap interval using seed 47053.

operation.reference_permission: At least two independent verified upstream records support the same locked claim, no selected record is conflicting, and lineage is known. If selector and interpreter have the same model identity, an independent review must also pass. The separately adjudicated operation_use_labels and review flag are available to the policy comparator but never to a selector or interpreter.

policies.naive_aggregation: Always permit; count every selected item as independent support and use its selector score as weight.
policies.global_label: Permit only if selector and interpreter model identities differ; apply this one label to all evidence and operations.
policies.metadata_only: Permit only when the selector and interpreter identities differ and selected items have at least two known upstream records with no duplicate/shared lineage; do not inspect source status or operation-use labels.
policies.operation_specific: Permit only when the named operation's reference conditions hold.

operation.ranking: Rank root causes by policy-eligible weighted support; selector score weights are normalized within a case. A denied operation has no pooled ranking. Compare each policy with naive aggregation.

repeatability.comparison: Canonical case-set, selection-trace, and complete-result SHA-256 digests must match. If model output differs, preserve both runs and report the nondeterminism; do not overwrite the first run.

claim_limit: The fixed local model pair, prompted selectors, small heldout set, authored synthetic evidence, and two replays do not establish real-world error rates, general model-family effects, UNREAL behavior, cross-target semantic equivalence, or a Semadmit enforcement rule.
